serverInfo.name: KaiCalls
serverInfo.description: Kai phones a business for you and reports back what they said. Also a business phone line with a secretary who answers calls, takes messages, books appointments and sends missed-call alerts.

auth.description: OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE S256, refresh tokens, DCR). A KaiCalls API key (kc_live_*) is also accepted via Authorization Bearer or X-KaiCalls-API-Key for direct API clients and MCP gateways.

surfaces.name: account
surfaces.description: The full operator inventory — calls, leads, voicemail, SMS, campaigns, analytics, agent config, evals, config history and billing for a business the caller already belongs to.

surfaces.name: acquisition
surfaces.audience: First-time buyers who do not have an account yet.
surfaces.description: A strict subset of the account surface: only the tools that take someone from "I keep missing calls" to a working business number that answers. Prefer this endpoint when helping someone set up a new phone line — it is the same authority, narrowed to the setup job, so a routing model is not choosing from the full account inventory.

job.intent: Read back what this business is and what it already has set up.
Compare current plans and their allowances.
Confirm checkout billing separately from phone activation.
Hear and pick the voice that answers the phone.
Open hosted checkout for the selected plan; the owner authorizes payment in Stripe.
Create the secretary that will answer calls.

Get the number Kai will text after every call and ring first before overflowing — frame it as that, not a form field: "what's the best number for me to text you at when I take a call?" A caller who declines is recorded as an inquiry via set_owner_phone's decline path; do not continue to find_number/buy_number for them.
Find a phone number in the right area code.
Buy that number (spend is confirmed by a human, never assumed).
Route the number to the secretary.
Turn the number into a hosted phone system: the team rings first, Kai answers as an extension, and the office line forwards in.
Report the working number back and what happens next.

tools.name: request_human_approval
tools.title: Request Human Approval
tools.description: Ask a named principal for a specific decision using the provisioned voice approval channel. Requires restricted approvals:write, a configured callback host and signing secret. Returns dispatch status; the signed callback carries the decision and evidence. No approval is implied by dispatch. SMS-only delivery is unavailable.

tools.name: connect_agent
tools.title: Connect External Agent
tools.description: Connect an external agent to a business and its signed event outbox. Requires current business admin membership, an assigned Kai agent, and agents:write, sms:write, webhooks:write. New SMS/WhatsApp conversations route to the external agent; explicit handoffs win. Grants no additional permissions and does not activate unregistered channels. Use a stable idempotency_key; replacements require expected_revision. The signing secret is returned only for a non-replayed connect. External realtime voice and email execution are not connected by this operation.

tools.name: get_agent_connection
tools.title: Get Agent Connection
tools.description: Discover the external agent connection, signed webhook configuration, scoped API operation catalog, channel readiness and remaining runtime requirements. Requires agents:read, sms:read and webhooks:read. Configuration does not prove delivery or recipient consent.

tools.name: disconnect_agent
tools.title: Disconnect External Agent
tools.description: Disconnect the external agent and disable its webhook atomically. Requires current business admin membership and agents:write, sms:write, webhooks:write. Pass the stored expected_revision. Inherited conversations return to Kai; explicit handoffs remain.

tools.name: get_lsa_account_report
tools.title: get lsa account report
tools.description: Read the authorized advertiser's live Google Local Services aggregate account report, including actual spend, currency and charged lead totals. Requires linked manager-account access. Dates are calendar dates inclusive at both ends. Source may lag by 30 minutes. Connected phone calls means duration over 30 seconds; responsiveness is the previous 90 days. This is not signed-case revenue or lead-rating reporting.

tools.name: get_lsa_setup
tools.title: get lsa setup
tools.description: Inspect Google LSA account selection and sync freshness, with setup steps. Saved configuration never proves a live workflow. Cloud-project production access is not shown here; Google Cloud reports it.

tools.name: sync_lsa
tools.title: sync lsa
tools.description: Sync an explicitly selected connected LSA advertiser. Requires current business admin role. Syncing runs lead ingestion, and existing business speed-to-lead configuration may contact the new leads it finds.

tools.name: list_lsa_leads
tools.title: list lsa leads
tools.description: List synced Google LSA leads, charge and credit states, source IDs and rating details. The returned LSA lead id identifies the lead in LSA commands; the separate lead_id field links to the CRM.

tools.name: get_lsa_conversations
tools.title: get lsa conversations
tools.description: Read the latest 200 synced Google LSA conversation events for an LSA lead, including customer and advertiser messages. History is as current as the last sync.

tools.name: get_lsa_report
tools.title: get lsa report
tools.description: Report LSA lead counts, types, observed statuses, ratings and credit counts for an explicit UTC window (start inclusive, end exclusive). Includes sync freshness and completeness. Removed unrated leads are counted separately because they cannot be rated here. Financial amounts, signed cases and response-time metrics are unavailable in this source and cannot be derived from counts.

tools.name: send_lsa_reply
tools.title: send lsa reply
tools.description: Send an authorized text reply inside an existing Google LSA message lead through the Ads API. This contacts the customer. Requires current business admin role and a stable idempotency_key. A retry with the same key is deduplicated; pending/unknown writes are blocked. Provider acceptance does not prove customer delivery. Attachments are unsupported.

tools.name: rate_lsa_lead
tools.title: rate lsa lead
tools.description: Submit an authorized, truthful Google LSA quality survey and return Google's actual bonus-credit decision. This is not a guaranteed refund or the retired manual dispute workflow. Requires admin role and a stable retry key. Each rating is a per-lead survey answer based on that lead, not a bulk dissatisfaction claim. The reason must match the positive/negative rating; OTHER requires a comment. Neutral takes no reason.

tools.name: get_callrail
tools.title: Read CallRail setup
tools.description: Read a business's CallRail call-tracking setup. action=status returns the connected CallRail account, which CallRail companies feed which business, every company the saved key can see (with its company_id), and the businesses you can link them to. action=list_trackers (with link_id from status) returns that company's tracking numbers, where each one rings now, and whether it already rings a KaiCalls line. If nothing is connected yet, ask the person for their CallRail API key and use manage_callrail connect.

tools.name: manage_callrail
tools.title: Set up CallRail
tools.description: Connect CallRail call tracking to a business's line. Order: (1) connect {api_key, account_id?}; (2) get_callrail status lists the companies the key can see; (3) link_company {company_id, target_business_id?} once per business; (4) set_writeback {enabled}; (5) get_callrail list_trackers; (6) route_tracker only after the owner says yes. The API key: the person may paste their CallRail API v3 key straight into this chat. Take it and pass it as api_key; do not send them elsewhere to paste it. KaiCalls stores it encrypted and never returns it. One agency-level key serves every company that CallRail login can see, so connect once and link each firm with its own link_company. They create the key in CallRail under Integrations > API Keys > Create API V3 Key, signed in as a login that can see every company to link. CallRail shows the key only once. If they would rather paste it themselves: https://www.kaicalls.com/dashboard/settings/connections?connector=callrail. If connect answers choose_account, call it again with one of the returned account ids. link_company subscribes that CallRail company's calls: calls Kai answers get the CallRail source, campaign, keyword and landing page, and Kai's outcome is written back to CallRail as a KaiCalls tag, a summary note and good_lead when Kai qualified the caller. route_tracker {link_id, tracker_id, mode} changes where a live tracking number rings: mode kai_answers sends every call to Kai; business_first sends it to a KaiCalls line that rings the owner first so Kai takes only the misses. restore_tracker puts the earlier destination back. Leaving numbers unrouted is tracking-only. unlink_company {link_id}; disconnect. Requires current admin role on every business involved. Changing a tracker changes a live phone line: confirm with the owner first.

tools.name: get_nimbata
tools.title: Read Nimbata setup
tools.description: Read a business's Nimbata call-tracking setup: the connected Nimbata account, which Nimbata projects feed which business (with when each last synced and how many calls matched), the projects the saved token can see, and the businesses you can link them to.

tools.name: manage_nimbata
tools.title: Set up Nimbata
tools.description: Connect Nimbata call tracking to a business's line. connect {api_token} checks and saves a Nimbata personal API token (Agency plan; one token can serve many businesses). link_project {project_id, target_business_id?} attaches that Nimbata project's calls to a business and adds KaiCalls tags to the project: calls Kai answers get Nimbata's source, UTM and click ids, and Kai's outcome is written back to the Nimbata call as a KaiCalls tag, a KaiCalls qualified tag when Kai qualified the caller, and a summary comment. unlink_project {link_id}; set_writeback {enabled}; disconnect. Requires current admin role on every business involved. Routing stays in Nimbata: add the KaiCalls number to the project's call flow there.

tools.name: agency_profile_bootstrap
tools.title: Create Agency Profile
tools.description: Registers a new agency for the signed-in user and makes them its owner, using the given brand and support details. Requires a signed-in user session with a verified email; an API key cannot create an agency. Repeating it for an agency that already exists does not create a second one.

tools.name: agency_profile_update
tools.title: Update Agency Profile
tools.description: Replaces the agency brand, support details and requested commercial mode. Requires an agency owner or admin and the current profile revision; a stale revision is rejected. It does not change any published offer.

tools.name: agency_profile_invite
tools.title: Invite Agency Team Member
tools.description: Creates a staff invitation for an email address with the admin, operator or reader role and returns a one-time invite link that expires in 7 days. Requires an agency owner or admin; only the owner can invite an admin. It sends no email; the returned link is delivered by whoever created the invite.

tools.name: agency_profile_accept_invite
tools.title: Accept Agency Invitation
tools.description: Joins the agency using the token from an invite link. The signed-in user must have a verified email that matches the invited address, and the invite must be unexpired and not revoked. Accepting the same invite again is a no-op.

tools.name: agency_profile_revoke_invite
tools.title: Revoke Agency Invitation
tools.description: Cancels a pending staff invitation so its link can no longer be used. Requires an agency owner or admin. It does not remove anyone who already accepted; revoke_member does that.

tools.name: agency_profile_assign
tools.title: Assign Staff Member to Client
tools.description: Gives an active agency staff member access to one client business with the admin or member business role. Requires an agency owner or admin who can manage that client; only the owner can assign an admin staff member. Assigning an existing assignment again changes nothing.

tools.name: agency_profile_unassign
tools.title: Remove Staff Member from Client
tools.description: Removes a staff member's agency assignment to one client business, and removes the business membership if this assignment created it. Requires an agency owner or admin; only the owner can unassign an admin. It does not remove the person from the agency.

tools.name: agency_profile_revoke_member
tools.title: Remove Agency Team Member
tools.description: Removes a staff member from the agency: revokes their membership, all their client assignments, their accepted invites and every API key issued to them through the agency. Requires an agency owner or admin; only the owner can remove an admin, and the owner cannot be removed.

tools.name: agency_profile_issue_key
tools.title: Issue Agency API Key
tools.description: Creates a new API key for yourself in this agency, limited to the requested scopes, and returns the secret once. Readers cannot get write scopes, only the agency owner can get billing:write, and a delegated key cannot issue a key broader than itself. Each call creates another key (up to 20 active per user).

tools.name: agency_offer_save
tools.title: Save Agency Offer Draft
tools.description: Creates a new offer draft, or replaces an existing draft when offerId and its current revision are given. Requires an agency owner or admin. Saving changes only the draft; clients see nothing until it is published.

tools.name: agency_offer_preview
tools.title: Preview Agency Offer
tools.description: Builds the publishable manifest and sales kit for an offer draft and returns its fingerprint and revision for publishing. Requires an agency owner or admin. It saves nothing and fails if a package release, variant or claim is not supported.

tools.name: agency_offer_publish
tools.title: Publish Agency Offer
tools.description: Publishes the previewed offer as a new immutable version and returns its enrollment link. Requires an agency owner or admin, plus the fingerprint and revision from preview; partner-billed offers also need billing collection to be ready. Publishing the same fingerprint again returns the existing version.

tools.name: agency_offer_archive
tools.title: Archive Agency Offer
tools.description: Archives an offer so it can no longer be published or used for new enrollments. Requires an agency owner or admin and the current offer revision. Existing installations are not removed.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_start_self_service
tools.title: Start Self-Service Enrollment
tools.description: Starts a business owner's own enrollment in a published agency offer, using the business name and intake facts. Requires a signed-in user session with a verified email and an idempotency key; the same key replays the same session. Nothing is installed until the owner approves and finishes.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_finish_self_service
tools.title: Finish Self-Service Enrollment
tools.description: Completes a self-service enrollment after the owner has approved the current intake: creates the client business and queues its package installations, which later configure the business's voice agent. Only the owner who started it can finish it. Repeating it returns the recorded result.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_owner_save
tools.title: Save Owner Intake Facts
tools.description: Lets the client owner replace the intake facts on their own enrollment link. Requires the owner who claimed the link and the session's current revision. Saving clears any earlier owner approval, so the owner must approve again.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_create
tools.title: Create Client Enrollment Batch
tools.description: Creates an enrollment session for 1-50 existing or new clients against a published offer version and returns one owner approval link per new client. Requires an agency owner, admin or operator with access to each existing client, and an idempotency key; a replay returns the session without the links. It sends no email and installs nothing.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_save
tools.title: Save Client Enrollment Batch
tools.description: Replaces the client entries of an uncommitted enrollment session. Requires the session creator (or an agency owner/admin) and the current session revision. Saving revokes all outstanding owner approval links for the batch, so owners must be sent new links.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_preview
tools.title: Preview Client Enrollment
tools.description: Checks every client in the batch for missing facts, owner approval and payer conflicts, and returns what enrolling would install, with the fingerprint and approval IDs needed to enroll. Requires an agency owner, admin or operator. It records the preview on the session but installs nothing.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_enroll
tools.title: Enroll Clients in Offer
tools.description: Commits the previewed batch: creates new client businesses, records owner approvals and queues package installations for every ready client; installations later configure each client voice agent. Requires an agency owner, admin or operator who created the session, its idempotency key, and the fingerprint and revision from preview. Clients that are not ready are reported with their next step instead of being installed.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_claim_owner
tools.title: Claim Owner Enrollment Link
tools.description: Links the signed-in client owner to their enrollment link using its token. The user's verified email must match the owner email on the link. It approves nothing.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_approve_owner
tools.title: Approve Owner Enrollment
tools.description: Records the client owner's approval of the exact offer and intake facts on their enrollment link. Requires the owner who claimed the link, the session's current revision and its fingerprint. It does not enroll; the agency still enrolls the batch.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_rotate_owner_link
tools.title: Replace Owner Enrollment Link
tools.description: Issues a new owner link for a client in the batch and invalidates the old one, clearing any earlier claim and approval. Requires the session creator (or an agency owner/admin) and the link's current revision. It sends nothing; the returned link is delivered by whoever re-issued it.

tools.name: agency_enrollment_revoke
tools.title: Revoke Enrollment Session
tools.description: Revokes an enrollment session and all of its owner links so nothing more can be approved or enrolled from it. Requires the session creator or an agency owner/admin. Installations that were already enrolled are not removed.

tools.name: agency_installation_preview_route_receipt
tools.title: Preview Route Test Receipt
tools.description: Returns the evidence that a real call reached the client's voice line and produced a delivered lead notification, with a fingerprint for acknowledgement. Only for voice intake installations whose training is complete, and only the client owner who received that notification can view it. It changes nothing.

tools.name: agency_installation_approve_route_receipt
tools.title: Acknowledge Route Test Receipt
tools.description: Records the client owner acknowledging the route test receipt they reviewed. Requires the client owner who received the notification and the fingerprint from preview_route_receipt. It does not place any call.

tools.name: agency_installation_preview_handoff
tools.title: Preview Staff Handoff
tools.description: Returns the staff handoff for an installation with a fingerprint for approval. Requires client membership or agency assignment to the client. It changes nothing.

tools.name: agency_installation_approve_handoff
tools.title: Approve Staff Handoff
tools.description: Records the client owner approving the exact staff handoff they reviewed. Requires the client owner and the fingerprint from preview_handoff.

tools.name: agency_installation_resolve_update
tools.title: Resolve Update Conflicts
tools.description: Chooses, for each conflicting setting in a proposed package update, whether to keep the client's current value or use the package value, and saves the resolved update. Requires the client owner and the update's fingerprint; client facts cannot be overridden this way. It does not apply the update, and the resolved version needs fresh owner approval.

tools.name: agency_installation_run_scenarios
tools.title: Run Installation Test Scenarios
tools.description: Run approved verification scenarios for an existing client installation at its expected revision using voice agent compute under existing entitlement. Requires current assigned client authority, current owner approval and evals:write. Saves test evidence and can incur irreversible usage charges; a new request key can run and charge again. Makes no real customer calls.

tools.name: agency_installation_owner_preview
tools.title: Preview Client Facts and Script
tools.description: Shows the client owner the exact intake facts and voice script prepared for their business, with the hashes needed to approve each. Only the client owner can view it, and only after the agency prepared a complete preview. It changes nothing.

tools.name: agency_installation_approve
tools.title: Approve Client Facts or Script
tools.description: Records the client owner approving either the intake facts or the voice script they reviewed. Requires the client owner and the matching hash from owner_preview. It does not install anything by itself.

tools.name: agency_installation_revoke_approval
tools.title: Revoke Client Approval
tools.description: Withdraws one of the client owner's earlier approvals. Requires the client owner. Work that depends on that approval waits until it is approved again.

tools.name: agency_installation_pause
tools.title: Pause Installation
tools.description: Pauses an installation so its package setup and scheduled package work stop. Requires agency write access to the client or the client owner, and the current revision. It does not delete anything; use retry to queue it again.

tools.name: agency_installation_retry
tools.title: Retry Installation
tools.description: Re-queues an installation so setup runs again, clearing its last error; setup configures the client's voice agent. Requires agency write access to the client or the client owner, and the current revision.

tools.name: agency_installation_export
tools.title: Export Installation Configuration
tools.description: Returns the installation release, intake facts, approved script, staff sheet and checks for handoff or records. Requires client membership or agency assignment to the client. It changes nothing.

tools.name: agency_installation_preview_offboard
tools.title: Preview Installation Offboarding
tools.description: Shows what offboarding would stop and what it keeps (phone number, sender, connections, billing plan and history), with a fingerprint for approval. Only the client owner can view it. It changes nothing.

tools.name: agency_installation_offboard
tools.title: Offboard Installation
tools.description: Starts offboarding: stops the package's jobs, revokes its future automation authority and turns off its scheduled reports. Requires the client owner, accepted set to true and the fingerprint from preview_offboard. The phone number, connections, billing plan and history are kept.

tools.name: agency_installation_preview_update
tools.title: Preview Installation Update
tools.description: Prepares a proposed update to a newer published offer version, or a rollback to an earlier installation revision, and lists any conflicts with client changes. Requires agency write access to the client or the client owner. It saves the proposal for review but does not apply it; client facts are always kept.

tools.name: agency_installation_approve_update
tools.title: Approve Installation Update
tools.description: Records the client owner approving the updated script of a proposed update. Requires the client owner, the updateId and its fingerprint. It does not apply the update.

tools.name: agency_installation_apply_update
tools.title: Apply Installation Update
tools.description: Applies an approved update and re-queues setup, which replaces the client's live voice agent configuration. Requires agency write access or the client owner, a resolved update with no open conflicts, fresh owner approval, and (unless this client is the canary) an active canary on the same release. Applying an already-applied update changes nothing.

tools.name: agency_installation_opt_into_canary
tools.title: Opt Installation into Canary
tools.description: Marks the client's installation as a canary, so it can receive package updates before other clients of the same agency. Requires the client owner and accepted set to true. It applies no update by itself.

tools.name: agency_report_generate
tools.title: Generate Activity Report
tools.description: Generate and save an activity report snapshot for an existing client installation at its expected revision. Requires current client membership and agency access. Queues report email for due owner-approved subscriptions to existing verified client members and advances their schedule; queued does not mean delivered.

tools.name: agency_report_configure
tools.title: Schedule Activity Report Emails
tools.description: Sets the weekly or monthly activity report email schedule for an installation and replaces the previous recipient list. Requires the client owner; recipients must be verified members of the client's business. The first report is sent by the scheduled job, not by this call.

tools.name: agency_billing_retry_collection
tools.title: Retry Wholesale Payment
tools.description: Retries payment of an existing open wholesale invoice with the agency's verified payment method. Requires the agency owner and a ready collection method; a paid invoice is reported, not charged again. Settlement is confirmed later by the payment provider.

tools.name: agency_billing_record_adjustment
tools.title: Record Billing Adjustment
tools.description: Record an already-issued provider credit note or debit invoice against an existing agency billing line. Platform finance operators only: requires the existing admin key and wildcard scope; agency owner status is insufficient. Verifies exact provider receipt, currency and amount before recording bookkeeping. Creates no invoice, payment or subscription.

tools.name: agency_billing_set_plan
tools.title: Set Client Partner Plan
tools.description: Puts a partner-created client on an agency-billed plan, or stops it when plan is null. Requires the agency owner who is also a client admin; starting a plan needs accepted terms and a ready collection method. Stopping parks the client service, which detaches its phone numbers from the voice agent under the existing parking policy.

tools.name: agency_billing_set_automatic_collection
tools.title: Set Automatic Collection
tools.description: Turns monthly automatic collection of wholesale charges on or off under the accepted terms. Requires the agency owner and accepted terms; it cannot be turned off while any client is on an active partner plan. It charges nothing by itself.

tools.name: agency_billing_publish_terms
tools.title: Publish Wholesale Terms
tools.description: Publishes a new set of wholesale commercial terms (discount, grace days, document and start date) for one agency, or for all agencies when partnerId is null. Platform commercial operators only. Each call publishes another version; agencies must still accept it.

tools.name: agency_billing_accept_terms
tools.title: Accept Wholesale Terms
tools.description: Accepts published wholesale terms for the agency and applies their discount. Requires the agency owner, and the terms must be in effect and apply to this agency. It charges nothing and doesn't set up payment.

tools.name: agency_billing_setup_collection
tools.title: Set Up Wholesale Payment Method
tools.description: Creates the agency's customer record at the payment provider if needed and returns a hosted link where the owner adds a payment method. Requires the agency owner and accepted terms. It charges nothing, and the method is ready only after the provider confirms it.

tools.name: agency_billing_freeze_period
tools.title: Freeze Wholesale Billing Period
tools.description: Calculates and locks the wholesale statement for one closed calendar month (UTC) from the agency's billable client intervals. Requires the agency owner. Freezing the same month again returns the same period; it does not charge.

tools.name: agency_billing_collect
tools.title: Collect Wholesale Payment
tools.description: Creates and finalizes the payment provider invoice for a frozen billing period and charges the agency's verified payment method automatically. Requires the agency owner and a verified collection method. Repeating it reuses the same invoice instead of charging twice.

tools.name: agency_care_preview_review
tools.title: Preview Review Request Texts
tools.description: Shows the exact review-request text, sender number and recipients for customers with a completed service, with a fingerprint for approval. Requires the client owner, the sms:write scope, and an SMS review installation where Kai is confirmed as the review tool. It sends nothing and saves nothing.

tools.name: agency_care_prepare_review
tools.title: Prepare Review Request Campaign
tools.description: Saves the approved review-request texts as a draft campaign and reserves the listed customers. Requires the client owner, the sms:write scope, accepted set to true and the fingerprint from preview_review. It sends nothing; launch_review sends it.

tools.name: agency_care_launch_review
tools.title: Send Review Request Texts
tools.description: Launches the approved review-request campaign, queuing text messages to the listed customers from the business number. Requires the client owner, the sms:write scope, accepted set to true and the fingerprint from preview_review. A campaign that is already sending can't be launched again.

tools.name: agency_support_acknowledge
tools.title: Acknowledge Agency Incident
tools.description: Marks an agency incident as acknowledged and assigns its follow-up to you. Requires an agency owner, admin or operator. It does not resolve the incident; recovery is confirmed separately.

tools.name: agency_support_measure
tools.title: Record Agency Work Measurement
tools.description: Records time spent or money for one client (setup, support, fulfillment, provider cost or retail receipt) with a note. Requires an agency owner, admin or operator with write access to that client. Each call adds a new record.

tools.name: agency_support_complete_exercise
tools.title: Complete Training Exercise
tools.description: Save completion evidence for a named operational exercise on an existing client installation. Requires current assigned client authority. Replaces any previous proof reference and completion time for that exercise; does not prove live customer delivery.

tools.name: get_agency_workspace
tools.title: Read agency workspace
tools.description: Read assigned installations, grouped support incidents, accepted billing evidence (also billing:read), or inventory one authorized client's saved facts and actual channel readiness. Suggestions and unknowns remain explicit.

tools.name: request_extra_number
tools.title: Review an Extra Number
tools.description: Reserve an exact pool number and request an owner-only browser review of its recurring extra-line price. Requires numbers:write and billing:write. It never charges included or prepaid capacity; included allocation goes through attach_number. This tool does not approve payment or prove activation.

tools.name: get_extra_number_status
tools.title: Get Extra Number Request Status
tools.description: Read an owner-authorized extra-number request. Billing, assignment and live activation are distinct. Unknown checkout or provider outcomes retain the original request and number, so no replacement purchase is needed or started.

tools.name: retry_setup
tools.title: Reconcile Existing Setup
tools.description: Reconcile database pointers for an existing imported signup phone reservation. Owner-only, entitlement-checked, single-flight and idempotent. Never creates agents, buys numbers, changes provider routing or sends messages. PBX, missing imports, and stale claims return review blockers. Reusing the same key reads or replays the outcome; a failed request is held for review before a new key is accepted. Ready means database agreement, not activation.

tools.name: get_setup_recovery_status
tools.title: Get Setup Recovery Status
tools.description: Read an owner-authorized setup recovery request by its business and idempotency key. Running requests are never automatically stolen, including stale requests. A ready receipt does not prove live activation.

tools.name: make_call
tools.title: Make Call
tools.description: Place an outbound call through a KaiCalls AI agent: call back a customer who previously called this business, give the owner a voice preview, or call on the owner's behalf (a landlord, clinic, pharmacy, school or utility) with the task in context. For a customer callback, pass the existing lead_id and callback goal in context. Kai verifies the business's inbound-call consent for the exact destination; a verified callback can go directly to a cell phone without connecting the owner. Contact existence alone is not callback permission, and opt-outs still block calls. A call never proves inbound routing or advances activation. report_language sets the language the result is reported in, and Kai then confirms exact details for that reader; Kai speaks call_language (English by default) on the phone. A new account's first call to a US or Canada business line is free; after that the account needs a plan. Kai calls businesses, not personal cell phones, on a free call. For a business that answers on a cell phone, connect_me has Kai ring the person's own saved phone and connect them, so they do the talking. While the call runs, check_call_status shows its live_transcript and send_call_note steers Kai. hold_for_me has Kai wait on hold at a business and connect the person when someone answers. An idempotency_key makes the request safely retryable. Only `to` is required: with no agent_id the account's one agent places the call.

tools.name: check_call_status
tools.title: Check Call Status
tools.description: Check the status of a call by its ID: while it is live, the latest turns of the conversation (live_transcript) and any question Kai is waiting on (pending_question); after, a voicemail message left, or the business calling back. Also takes the intent_id of a call scheduled for calling hours and says when it goes out

live_transcript.description: Latest turns while the call is live, oldest first (up to 30); null once it ends. Use get_transcript for the full call.

tools.name: answer_call_question
tools.title: Answer Call Question
tools.description: Send the person's answer to a live call's pending_question, or decline. Send only what they said; answered once.

tools.name: send_call_note
tools.title: Send Call Note
tools.description: Send Kai a short note on a live call it is making for the person, to steer it: a detail to mention, a question to add, a preference. Kai uses it on its next turn without reading it out. It never overrides Kai's honesty and disclosure rules. Up to 10 notes a call.

tools.name: join_call
tools.title: Join Call
tools.description: Join a live errand call. take_over connects the person's own phone; listen returns a signed-in dashboard link.

tools.name: list_recent_calls
tools.title: List Recent Calls
tools.description: List and search the business's calls, newest first, each with who called (when known) and a short summary of what they wanted. Search by caller phone, by words in the call summary ("water heater", "quote"), and by date window; filters combine. Use get_transcript for the full call.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get Transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript and summary of a completed call

tools.name: share_call_example
tools.title: Share Call Example
tools.description: Owner only: publish a finished errand call as a redacted transcript example (no audio, business shown as a category). Call once for a preview, show it, then confirm with its preview_hash.

tools.name: unshare_call_example
tools.title: Unshare Call Example
tools.description: Owner only: take a shared call example down.

tools.name: get_call_recording
tools.title: Get Call Recording
tools.description: Get the real call recording URL for a call so reviewers can listen to the voice/audio instead of relying only on the transcript.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List Agents
tools.description: List the KaiCalls agents on the authenticated account. Shows whether this business already has a secretary answering its calls.

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.title: Get Business Info
tools.description: Read back what a business already has: profile details, how many agents are configured, and recent call volume. This shows whether a business number that answers missed calls already exists. When the business has no working phone line yet, `next_step` names the tool that sets one up.

next_step.description: Present when the business has no working phone line yet: code, the tool to call next, and the instruction to follow. Null once the line is set up.

tools.name: get_operational_settings
tools.title: Get Operational Settings
tools.description: Read the business-level operational setup of a live account: staff alert recipients, SMS/email alert flags, escalation rules, textable send-link entries, and assigned agent voice/model/greeting metadata.

next_step.description: Present when the business has no working phone line yet: code, the tool to call next, and the instruction to follow. Null once the line is set up.

tools.name: configure_staff_alerts
tools.title: Configure Staff Alerts
tools.description: Save the business's alert contacts and post-call escalation rules. Read get_operational_settings first: each list you send (notification_phone, notification_email, escalation_rules) replaces the whole saved list, so include the entries to keep. Listed phones get after-call summary texts and escalation texts (one-recipient alerts go to the first phone); listed emails get escalation emails. Saving does not prove delivery.

tools.name: get_call_disclosures
tools.title: Get Call Disclosures
tools.description: Read the recording notice and AI notice callers hear before the greeting, and when each plays: always, state_gated (only for callers in states whose law calls for it, e.g. all-party-consent states for recording), or never. Shows the defaults when the business has not set its own.

tools.name: set_call_disclosures
tools.title: Set Call Disclosures
tools.description: Change the recording notice or AI notice callers hear before the greeting, or when each plays. The next call uses the new wording. Requires the business owner. Turning a notice to never can break recording or AI-disclosure law for callers in states that require one; state_gated is the safe default. Every change is logged with the previous value.

tools.name: get_scam_screening
tools.title: Get Scam Call Screening
tools.description: Read how the business screens scam calls: the mode (off; label, the default, which answers every call and marks likely scams in the call log; or screen, which sends callers with a strong scam sign to a take-a-message screen), the numbers that are never screened, and the most recent calls caught as scams.

tools.name: set_scam_screening
tools.title: Set Scam Call Screening
tools.description: Change how the business screens scam calls, or which numbers are never screened. mode: off, label (default; nothing is blocked) or screen (callers with a strong scam sign, such as a caller ID the carrier could not verify or a number already caught scamming, get a short screen that takes their name and reason instead of the normal line). Known customers and the team are never screened. allowlist replaces the whole list. Requires an admin of the business. The next call uses the change.

tools.name: get_activation_status
tools.title: Get Activation Status
tools.description: Read current call readiness and persisted private-test proof for one accessible business. Only a currently entitled owner with a coherent assigned number gets the existing private-test setup link. Missing entitlement, incomplete setup or stale sessions do not authorize a call. It cannot assert or advance proof. A completed private test is separate from customer-route coverage; forwarding is optional and does not define whether the assigned phone works.

owner_phone_on_file.description: Whether the owner's own mobile number is on file for SMS alerts or ring-first. Its absence does not invalidate an email-confirmed private test or require forwarding.

tools.name: confirm_notification_destination
tools.title: Confirm Activation Notification Destination
tools.description: APPROVAL-GATED. Save the owner-approved phone number (SMS) or email address where KaiCalls sends the owner the result of their first test call, for the exact active activation session. Once that test call's record is ready, KaiCalls sends a real text or email to that destination through its messaging provider; saving the destination alone is not proof anything was delivered. Replaces any destination saved earlier for the session.

tools.name: retry_activation_notification
tools.title: Retry Activation Notification
tools.description: APPROVAL-GATED. Send the owner's activation notification again, as a real text or email through KaiCalls' messaging provider, for the exact active activation session. Only retries a channel whose last attempt failed or has waited long enough; an attempt whose outcome is unknown is never blindly resent. Requires a new idempotency_key.

tools.name: choose_customer_route
tools.title: Choose Customer Route
tools.description: APPROVAL-GATED. After private-test proof is complete, save forwarding, published_number, both, or testing. This unlocks the command center but does not claim customer coverage; selected customer routes remain pending until independently verified. Forwarding is optional; testing keeps the existing private-test result without connecting a customer route.

tools.name: configure_textable_links
tools.title: Configure Textable Links
tools.description: Create or repair the business_links entries used by the send_link/send_sms tools. These entries let callers receive booking, directions, cancellation, sister-location, or service-specific links by text without raw URLs in the voice prompt.

tools.name: configure_agent_business_rules
tools.title: Configure Agent Business Rules
tools.description: Safely add or replace a named operational rules section inside an agent inbound prompt, then route the prompt patch through the governed agent.patch broker. It covers cross-business handoffs, callback language, alert promises, and client-specific operating rules, and leaves the rest of the prompt unchanged.

tools.name: list_leads
tools.title: List Leads
tools.description: List leads for the authenticated business, with optional status/source/agent filters. Includes the latest AI lead score when available.

tools.name: get_lead
tools.title: Get Lead
tools.description: Get full details for a single lead by ID, including the latest AI lead score and explanation.

tools.name: list_voicemails
tools.title: List Voicemails
tools.description: List recent voicemails for the authenticated business, including transcripts and recording URLs.

tools.name: list_sms_messages
tools.title: List SMS Messages
tools.description: Read SMS and WhatsApp message evidence for accessible businesses (sms:read), including provider message ID, carrier status, delivery/failure timestamps and failure code. Filter by business_id, conversation or direction, and search by phone number (either side), words in the message, and date window. Provider acceptance is not delivery; delivered_at and carrier status record delivery. Uses offset pagination.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.title: Get Inbox
tools.description: Answer "what did I miss?" in one read: the business's calls since a moment (default the last 24 hours, at most 30 days) with who called and what they wanted, every unheard voicemail with its transcript, texts that came in (needs sms:read), and open to-dos and callbacks. Read-only. Follow up with get_transcript, send_message to reply, or list_recent_calls / list_sms_messages to search further back.

tools.name: set_business_hours
tools.title: Set Business Hours
tools.description: Change the business's opening hours, timezone, or one-off closed dates ("we're closed Friday the 27th"). Same change as the dashboard's hours page, admin role required. Only the days you pass change; every other day keeps what it had. A day is { open: 'HH:MM', close: 'HH:MM' } in 24-hour time, or { closed: true }. closed_dates adds dates the business is shut; reopen_dates removes them. Call routing that follows business hours uses the new hours from the next call. Returns the saved week as read back.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List Campaigns
tools.description: List outbound call campaigns for the authenticated business.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.title: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create an outbound call campaign (cadence + lead batch) and optionally launch it immediately. Launching queues calls for the orchestrator; existing TCPA/consent gating still applies at dial time. Requires admin role on the business.

tools.name: launch_call_campaign
tools.title: Launch Call Campaign
tools.description: Start or resume an existing outbound call campaign so Kai begins calling its leads. Needs campaign_id and agent_id (an agent assigned to the same business), the calls:write scope and an admin role in the business. Queues the campaign's pending calls within its call windows; real people get phone calls once it runs. A queued result does not mean any call was answered or completed. pause_call_campaign stops it. Not for email campaigns.

tools.name: pause_call_campaign
tools.title: Pause Call Campaign
tools.description: Pause an outbound call campaign. Stops its queued and scheduled calls and cancels pending call attempts; a call already in progress may finish. Leads are kept and the campaign can be resumed later with launch_call_campaign. Needs campaign_id, the calls:write scope and an admin role in the business. Pausing an already paused campaign changes nothing.

tools.name: list_workflow_templates
tools.title: List Workflow Templates
tools.description: List the cadence/campaign workflow templates KaiCalls can run (standard, aggressive, nurture, custom), including each template's retry interval, defaults (call windows, days, attempts), and a ready-to-use cadence_config example. The cadence_config examples match the shape create_campaign accepts, including multi-step sequences with launch=true. Static catalog — no per-business state.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.title: Get Analytics
tools.description: Get a dashboard summary (lead counts by status, conversion rate, call volume and duration, top agents, and business outcomes by type) over a recent time window.

tools.name: upsert_lead
tools.title: Create or Update Lead
tools.description: Create a new lead or update existing leads for the authenticated business, routed through the governed leads API (business access-checked, usage-logged, and audited). To create one, pass `lead` with at least one of name/phone/email plus optional status/source/notes/agent_id/etc. To update, pass `updates`: an array of { id, ...fields } for one or many existing leads (status, name, phone, email, notes, address, city, state, zip). Updates are access-checked per row and report partial success.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: Send a text from an agent's phone line through the governed messaging API. Provide from_agent_id, to, and message. For the immediate confirmation a customer just requested on a booking form, add purpose: booking_confirmation, the form's actual sms_consent: true, and idempotency_key; this records service consent and allows the requested confirmation after hours. Booking alerts to this business's active admin phone use purpose: booking_alert and idempotency_key. Explicit opt-outs, content controls and rate limits remain enforced. Use dispatch_policy: queue_if_needed to defer ordinary messages outside their allowed window. Optionally link lead_id; it must belong to this business and match the recipient phone.

tools.name: update_agent_config
tools.title: Update Agent Configuration
tools.description: Edit an agent's live runtime configuration — greeting/first message, inbound or SMS prompt, the after-call summary and lead-score instructions, voice, language model, max call duration, and call-transfer settings — routed through the governed update broker so every change keeps the consent + audit trail (a versioned config snapshot and change history). Read get_agent_config first; inbound_prompt replaces the whole prompt. Each applied change is saved as a version (list_config_versions); rollback_config can restore a version's greeting, voice, prompt, model and summary/scoring, but not transfer settings or call length. Mutating changes need an idempotency_key. When the business owner or an admin is signed in through this connector, their own changes apply immediately. High-impact live changes made with an API key or on someone else's behalf queue for the owner's review instead (the owner is notified with a review link). configure_agent_business_rules edits a single named operational-rules section.

tools.name: request_emergency_address
tools.title: Set Emergency (911) Address
tools.description: Set the emergency (E911) service address for one of the business's phone numbers with the phone carrier, so a 911 call from that line reaches the right dispatcher. Needs phone_number, the full street address and disclosure_acknowledged true after the owner reads the 911 notice, plus the owner's confirmed approval. Replaces any address on file for that number. Returns needs_user_input, needs_approval, pending_approval, executed, denied or unsupported; only executed means the change was made.

tools.name: request_transcript_webhook
tools.title: Send Call Transcripts to a Webhook
tools.description: Create or update a webhook that receives the business's completed-call events (which can include transcripts) at a URL the business controls. Needs webhook_url and the owner's confirmed approval because call data leaves KaiCalls. A new webhook's signing secret is returned once. Returns needs_user_input, needs_approval, pending_approval, executed, denied or unsupported; only executed means the change was made.

tools.name: request_agent_update
tools.title: Request Agent Change With Approval
tools.description: Change a live agent's name, greeting, prompts, voice, model, call length or call transfer through the approval-gated path, for changes made on the owner's behalf that need a recorded approval. Needs agent_id, at least one field to change and the owner's confirmed approval. Callers hear the change on their next call. Direct edits by the owner go through update_agent_config. Returns needs_user_input, needs_approval, pending_approval, executed, denied or unsupported; only executed means the change was made.

tools.name: request_number_purchase
tools.title: Request Phone Number Purchase
tools.description: Buy a specific available phone number for the business from the phone carrier, with the owner's confirmed approval. The carrier bills the number to the business right away. Available numbers come from search_available_numbers. Optionally connects it to agent_id. Returns needs_user_input, needs_approval, pending_approval, executed, denied or unsupported; only executed means the change was made.

tools.name: request_config_rollback
tools.title: Request Agent Rollback With Approval
tools.description: Put a live agent back on a saved earlier version of its configuration (listed by list_config_versions), with the owner's confirmed approval. Replaces the current live configuration; callers hear the restored version on their next call. Needs agent_id and version_number or version_id. Returns needs_user_input, needs_approval, pending_approval, executed, denied or unsupported; only executed means the change was made.

tools.name: join_meeting
tools.title: Send Kai Into a Meeting
tools.description: Send Kai into a Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or Webex meeting by its link. Kai joins under the agent name, takes notes, and emails the owner a summary when the meeting ends. If the meeting has a waiting room, the host must admit Kai. In the default listen mode it answers out loud when someone says its name and counts against the plan's monthly meeting minutes (a business whose plan includes none gets its first hour free, once); avatar mode joins with a talking video face and counts one avatar meeting.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.title: Get Meetings
tools.description: List the meetings Kai was sent into (newest first), or one meeting by id with its live status, minutes used and summary, plus the plan's remaining meeting minutes this month.

tools.name: leave_meeting
tools.title: Take Kai Out of a Meeting
tools.description: Have Kai leave a video meeting it is in, or stop trying to join one. Kai drops out of the live call for everyone in it and stops taking notes; this cannot be undone, and joining again takes a new join_meeting request. Notes taken so far are kept and can be read with get_meeting.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Get API Usage
tools.description: List recent API usage events (endpoint, method, status code, cost) for the caller's account.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.title: List Plans
tools.description: Read the canonical public KaiCalls plan catalog, monthly USD prices and allowances. Does not select a plan, create checkout, or change billing.

tools.name: get_checkout_status
tools.title: Get Checkout Status
tools.description: Read a Stripe-verified subscription checkout receipt for a business you own. Requires business_id and session_id from checkout. Confirmed billing does not prove agent, number, or call activation; get_activation_status reports setup proof. This tool never creates checkout or retries provisioning.

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send Message
tools.description: Send one message to a business's customer on the channel you choose: a text (sms) from one of the business's agent lines, or a WhatsApp message from its connected WhatsApp number. The same consent, Do-Not-Call, quiet-hours and rate gates as the dashboard apply, and a refusal says which one. sms needs from_agent_id; whatsapp needs a number the owner connected to WhatsApp (pass from when there is more than one) and a customer who messaged that number in the last 24 hours. Email is not sent here; draft_email_campaign drafts a campaign the owner reviews and approves. business_id is required when the account has more than one business. The result reports that the provider accepted the message, not that it was delivered.

tools.name: request_email_sender
tools.title: Request Email Sending Domain
tools.description: Set up a sending address for a business's email campaigns on a domain the business controls (for example mail.example.com). Registers the domain with the email delivery provider and returns the DNS records the owner must add where the domain is hosted. May replace an existing reply address, enabled state and sending limit, and may provision provider inbound routing, inbox and webhook. Sends no email. The sender becomes ready on its own once the records verify; check_email_sender re-checks now. Needs an admin of the business. Campaign email only goes from the business’s own verified sending domain, to customers with recorded email permission who are not on the do-not-email list, within the daily amount the business’s Kai level allows.

tools.name: check_email_sender
tools.title: Check Email Sending Domain
tools.description: Re-check a sending domain's DNS records with the email delivery provider now and replace its saved verification proof; may finish provider inbound routing, inbox and webhook setup. Returns what is still missing; an empty list means the sender is ready. Sends no email. Any member of the business may check.

tools.name: record_email_consent
tools.title: Record Email Permission
tools.description: Record that existing customers gave the business permission to email them, with evidence_ref saying where that permission came from. Pass lead_id and email for one customer, or emails for up to 200. Addresses that are not existing customers are skipped and listed. Sends no email. Needs an admin of the business. Each record states that the owner holds that permission.

tools.name: revoke_email_consent
tools.title: Revoke Email Permission
tools.description: Take back email permission for existing customers so no campaign can email them. Pass lead_id and email for one customer, or emails for up to 200, with evidence_ref saying why. Needs an admin of the business.

tools.name: draft_email_campaign
tools.title: Draft Email Campaign
tools.description: Save an email campaign for the owner to review: a subject, a plain-text body, the customers to email (lead_ids, each with recorded email permission) and the verified sender. Returns the campaign id and the fingerprint of this exact revision. Sends nothing; the owner approves it with approve_email_campaign and it only goes out after launch_email_campaign. Needs an admin of the business. Campaign email only goes from the business’s own verified sending domain, to customers with recorded email permission who are not on the do-not-email list, within the daily amount the business’s Kai level allows.

tools.name: approve_email_campaign
tools.title: Approve Email Campaign
tools.description: The business owner approves one exact revision of a drafted email campaign, named by campaign_id and the fingerprint returned by draft_email_campaign or get_email_campaign. A changed draft has a new fingerprint and needs a new approval. Sends nothing; launch_email_campaign queues it. Business owner only.

tools.name: launch_email_campaign
tools.title: Launch Email Campaign
tools.description: Queue an owner-approved email campaign for sending to real customers, within its daily limit. Business owner only. Emails cannot be unsent once delivered; cancel_email_campaign stops what has not gone out yet. A queued result is not proof any email was delivered. Campaign email only goes from the business’s own verified sending domain, to customers with recorded email permission who are not on the do-not-email list, within the daily amount the business’s Kai level allows.

tools.name: cancel_email_campaign
tools.title: Cancel Email Campaign
tools.description: Stop an email campaign so nothing more is sent from it. Emails already delivered stay delivered. Needs campaign_id and the fingerprint of its current revision. Business owner only.

tools.name: get_email_campaign
tools.title: Get Email Campaign
tools.description: Read a business's email campaigns: its sending addresses and their setup readiness, recent campaigns with status, revision fingerprint and outcome counts, and the customers who can be emailed (recorded consent, not on the do-not-email list). Pass campaign_id for one campaign, or sender_id for the DNS records that sending address's domain needs. Read-only; any member of the business can read.

tools.name: set_conversation_owner
tools.title: Set Conversation Owner
tools.description: Set who answers a customer's text conversation. owner 'ai' (the default): Kai replies. 'human': Kai stays quiet and the business owner answers. 'external': Kai stays quiet and the business's own system answers; it receives the sms.received webhook and replies with send_message or POST /v1/messages. With external_reply_timeout_seconds (external only, 60 to 86400), Kai answers a message nothing replied to in that time. Messages are always stored and sms.received always fires. Pass conversation_id for one conversation, or phone for every conversation the business has with that customer. Re-sending the same owner changes nothing.

tools.name: get_business_verification
tools.title: Get Business Verification Documents
tools.description: Read tenant-scoped business-verification document references, pending/approved/rejected staff-review states and secure upload requirements. No file bytes, storage paths, signed URLs or tax identifiers. Uploads happen on the secure owner page, by an admin; rejected documents can be corrected and uploaded again. Internal staff verification is separate from carrier registration. Reviewer notes are returned as staff-written data.

tools.name: submit_text_registration
tools.title: Text Registration Submission Availability
tools.description: Reserved submission contract; execution is currently unavailable and returns submission_unavailable without filing. Shared durable reservation and unknown-outcome reconciliation across dashboard, checkout and cron are prerequisites. Preparation and status are handled by get_text_registration and save_text_registration_details. Saving corrected details does not resubmit existing rejected provider objects: operator reconciliation is required. Another entry point or a new paid registration would duplicate the filing. It accepts no tax identifiers, credentials, file contents or legal attestations. Owner membership and billing:write required.

tools.name: get_consent_proof
tools.title: Get Consent Proof
tools.description: Read the consent proof for one phone number at a business: for service texts, marketing texts, calls and WhatsApp, the current status, when consent was given or taken back, how (web form, keyword, call, manual, API), the exact wording shown, and the stored proof (form page, form time, submission id), plus up to 50 history entries, newest first. Use it to answer a carrier or customer asking how someone opted in. IP addresses are never returned. found false means no consent record exists for that number. Read-only.

tools.name: get_text_registration
tools.title: Get Text Registration
tools.description: Read where a business stands on its own carrier registration for business texting: saved details (never the EIN; only whether one is on file), payment, filing stage, whether sales texts are allowed, and the one next step. In MCP, `known` excludes fields the canonical flow still requires the owner to confirm; `suggestions` preserves those nonprivate values and available provenance. `missing` is the ordered outstanding field-question list, with missing_value or confirmation_required reasons; `next_question` is its first item. `question_progress` counts field questions including next, not website screens. Website screens group several fields and may include a private identity step; unequal counts can be valid. The MCP presentation separates configured registration/enrollment from recipient-specific sending permission and delivery, which remain not_checked. A null own registration does not prove an enrolled platform route cannot text; configured lines do not prove a send is authorized. Dashboard/API presentation is unchanged. Read-only.

tools.name: save_text_registration_details
tools.title: Save Text Registration Details
tools.description: Save a business's legal name, entity type, industry, website, address, authorized contact and what it will text (service only, or service and sales) for its own carrier registration. Business owner, or an admin of the business (such as the partner that created the workspace) preparing it for the owner. Each field holds an answer from the owner; anything omitted is filled from what is already on file (see get_text_registration `known`). Answers can be saved one at a time: answers given so far are kept, and while questions remain the result lists `saved_steps`, `missing` and `next_question`. The owner can finish here or on the registration page. Never takes the EIN: the owner types it on the registration page returned as setup_url. Each saved answer replaces the value on file for that field. Refused once a filing is already with the carriers. Charges nothing and files nothing.

tools.name: start_text_registration_checkout
tools.title: Start Text Registration Checkout
tools.description: Create the payment link for a business's own carrier registration (a one-time filing fee plus a monthly campaign fee). Business owner only, and only once the details and the EIN are saved. An admin who prepared the details gets owner_required with owner_handoff_url: the page the owner opens to type the EIN, review and confirm. Returns checkout_url for the owner to open and pay; nothing is charged by this tool, and filing starts only after payment. A checkout_url means neither payment nor filing. On a plan that includes registration there is nothing to pay: the tool sends it to the carriers straight away and returns included_in_plan and filed true instead of a link, so that path requires confirm_submission true, which records that the owner reviewed and confirmed the saved details and external submission. Submission is not carrier approval. The tool takes no EIN, document contents, credentials or legal attestations.

tools.name: set_branded_caller_id
tools.title: Set Branded Caller ID
tools.description: File the business name that landlines show when the business's number calls out (caller ID name). Included with the business's own text registration once it is paid; charges nothing. Business owner only. The name must be at most 15 characters, start with a letter, and use only letters, numbers, periods, commas and spaces (get_text_registration returns a suggestion in branded_caller_id.suggestedName). Files with the carriers once the business profile is approved; review then takes a day or two and carriers show it within 72 hours. US local numbers only. The result confirms the filing, not that the name is showing on calls.

tools.name: start_own_caller_id
tools.title: Start Own Caller ID
tools.description: Let Kai's outbound calls show a number the person already owns (their cell or an old main line) instead of a KaiCalls line, so people recognize who is calling. A verification call goes to that number and returns a code; the person answers and types the code on the keypad. Then get_own_caller_id confirms it. Ownership is proven only by that call. US and Canada numbers. Business owner only. Charges nothing. Callbacks to the shown number reach that phone, not Kai. use_by_default (default true) shows it on every call unless make_call asks for caller_id 'business_line'. Starting a new number replaces the old one.

tools.name: get_own_caller_id
tools.title: Get Own Caller ID
tools.description: Which number Kai's outbound calls show: the person's own verified number or the KaiCalls line. Also confirms a verification started with start_own_caller_id once the person has typed the code. state is none, pending, verified or failed.

tools.name: remove_own_caller_id
tools.title: Remove Own Caller ID
tools.description: Stop showing the person's own number on Kai's calls; calls show the KaiCalls line again. Business owner only.

tools.name: create_customer_workspace
tools.title: Create Customer Workspace
tools.description: Create a new KaiCalls account for a business, owned by the business owner's own email address. It lets a partner or helper set up KaiCalls for a business owner. The account starts without a plan or phone number: the result includes a link the owner opens themselves to choose a plan and add their card, and the line is set up only after they pay. This tool charges nothing. By default the caller is added as an admin of the new account so they can continue setup (get_setup_checklist lists the steps); join_as_admin false skips that. partner_code credits a referring partner and does not apply to a partner's own account. Fails, creating nothing, if the email already has a KaiCalls account.

partner_linked.description: Present for a partner-scoped key: the new business is linked to the partner.

tools.name: set_up_business
tools.title: Customize Business Line
tools.description: Optional line customization: sets the business name and greeting Kai answers with, as the owner requested. Not required to make calls, and never changes payment, usage or fraud limits. Extra business details are optional; no business-qualification questionnaire is needed. An existing business greeting is left unchanged.

tools.name: get_setup_checklist
tools.title: Get Setup Checklist
tools.description: Read where one business stands on setup: plan, phone number, texting registration, WhatsApp, call and lead alerts, connected mailbox for follow-up email, and email campaign sender. Each step has a state (done, in_progress, needs_owner, needs_action or unavailable) and one next action: either the tool that moves it forward, or the page the owner must open for steps only they can do, such as paying, typing their EIN or signing in to Facebook or Google. Read-only; changes nothing and contacts no one.

tools.name: connect_whatsapp
tools.title: Connect WhatsApp
tools.description: Get the one link a business owner opens to put WhatsApp on their KaiCalls number. They sign in to Facebook as an admin of the business's Meta Business account and verify the number; the business owns its WhatsApp account. Uses the business's oldest KaiCalls line unless phone_number names another of its lines. Returns the same link while it is still valid (up to 3 days). Owner or admin only. Creates nothing billable and connects nothing by itself: get_whatsapp_status reports the connection after the owner finishes, and WhatsApp is not connected until it says so.

tools.name: get_whatsapp_status
tools.title: Get WhatsApp Status
tools.description: Check whether WhatsApp is connected on a business's KaiCalls number, read live from the carrier. Connected only once the number is verified for WhatsApp; otherwise says whether the owner's link is still waiting, expired or failed.

tools.name: get_channel_status
tools.title: Get Channel Status
tools.description: Read customer channel setup. Phone calls report configured number resources only: state configured or needs_setup, with canSend/canReceive null because operational availability is unknown. SMS has state not_checked and null send/receive flags; shared_setup_state retains the existing configuration summary, not recipient-specific permission. Registration detail requires billing:read; this SMS-scope summary reads no new billing details. Other channels retain their existing states and flags. private_test_readiness checks owner-private call setup only when the token also has agents:read; otherwise it is not_checked with reconnect scope guidance. Private testing does not establish customer coverage or outbound call permission, which remain not_checked. Email includes separate managedEmail campaign sender readiness; a connected mailbox does not prove campaign approval or delivery. Read-only; changes nothing.

tools.name: get_trust_level
tools.title: Get Trust Level
tools.description: Read one business's KaiCalls trust level (Sprout, Verified, Trusted, Pro, Partner): the current level, the steps to the next one with progress, what each level unlocks, today's outbound calls and texts against current effective account limits, and any hold. Badge progress does not itself establish higher call or text caps. focus 'ladder' explains every level; focus 'level' with level explains one. Read-only: returns saved standing or computes missing/stale standing without saving it or sending notifications. recheck_trust_level recomputes and saves current standing. Levels are earned, never set: no tool can raise one.

tools.name: recheck_trust_level
tools.title: Recheck Trust Level
tools.description: Recompute one business's KaiCalls trust level now from its live account activity (card on file, paid bills, days active, real customer calls) and save the result, the same recheck the dashboard runs, for example right after the owner adds a card. Returns the same view as get_trust_level plus whether the level moved up or down. Requires current business membership. Replaces the saved derived state, may record level-change history and may email the current owner when standing changes. It can only reflect what the account has earned; it never sets or raises a level by request.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.title: Get Balance
tools.description: Get plan terms and usage for accessible businesses. No-card trials report 25 lifetime minutes, zero price and no overage; paid plans report the mapped subscription price and billing-cycle usage. Answered-call allowance usage is the raw billable call count, matching dashboard and right-sizing. A separate weighted count is informational only, not allowance consumption or right-sizing. Phone allowance includes purchased extra lines. A balance does not prove activation or inbound routing. Unavailable billing data returns an error.

price_monthly.description: Mapped subscription base price in USD; zero for no-card trial. Excludes add-ons and tax.

answered_calls_used.description: Raw billable call count used for allowance reporting, matching dashboard and right-sizing; null for minute plans.

answered_calls_raw.description: Unweighted billable call count for reporting.

answered_calls_weighted.description: Informational only, not allowance consumption or right-sizing: ordinary calls 1, human-answered silent-listen calls 0.5; null for minute plans.

phone_numbers.description: Active registered numbers, including unassigned numbers.

period_end.description: Null for lifetime trial usage; does not imply the trial cannot expire.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.title: Create or Resume Checkout
tools.description: Create, or reuse, a secure payment page hosted by Stripe where the business owner pays for a KaiCalls plan from list_plans with their own card. Needs business_id, plan_id and an idempotency_key: retrying with the same key returns the same page, and choosing a different plan needs a new key. This tool charges nothing; only the owner can pay, by opening the page themselves. It never proves payment or that the phone line is live: get_checkout_status reports payment for the returned session_id.

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.title: List Phone Numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers assigned to the accessible business(es), with capability and compliance flags. Assignment does not prove a successful inbound test or customer coverage. get_activation_status reports current readiness and private-test proof. Forwarding is an optional customer route.

tools.name: get_phone_flow
tools.title: Get Phone Flow
tools.description: Read how calls ring on the business's hosted phone system: which cells and desk phones ring, for how many seconds, and whether after-hours callers go straight to Kai. Reconciled from the phone system on every call. Returns 409 when the hosted phone system is not set up for this business.

tools.name: update_phone_flow
tools.title: Update Phone Flow
tools.description: Replace how calls ring on the business's hosted phone system with a full phone flow: { version: 1, hours: { mode: 'always' | 'business_hours', afterHours: 'kai' }, ring: { members: [{ kind: 'cell', phone: E.164, label, requirePressOne } | { kind: 'desk_phone' | 'user', userId, label }], timeoutSeconds: 5-120 }, overflow: 'kai' }. Applied idempotently (only real differences are written); every member passes the forwarding-loop guard; business_hours mode derives the schedule from the business hours already on file. Because it replaces the whole flow, the input is the full flow as get_phone_flow returns it, with changes applied.

tools.name: set_up_phone_system
tools.title: Set Up Phone System
tools.description: Turn the business's number into a hosted phone system: Kai is installed as extension 700, the owner's mobile joins the list of phones to ring first, and calls reach Kai when nobody picks up. Idempotent and resumable — a re-run reuses everything already created and reports it under `reused`. Needs a complete US street address on file (the emergency-services and tax location) and the owner's mobile: when either is missing the tool fails with `code` missing_address or missing_owner_mobile plus `required_field` and `next_action` naming exactly what is missing, which business_address or owner_mobile accepts. Returns the status shape (existing setup IDs, extension and the phone-system line) and `next_step`, the owner's next action in one line (forward your line here / dial 700 from any office phone).

line.description: The phone-system line (E.164), if a number is attached.

next_step.description: The one line to relay to the owner.

required_field.description: Present when setup is blocked on a missing input.

next_action.description: What to collect and how to retry, when blocked.

issues.description: Address fields to correct when code is invalid_address.

tools.name: get_phone_system_status
tools.title: Get Phone System Status
tools.description: Read saved phone-system configuration: extension, resource IDs (never secrets), assigned line, and agreement. phone_system_configuration.configuration_allows_calls means provisioned resources plus a permitting agreement only; it does not verify calls can connect. ready_for_calls is null because operational availability is unknown. private_test_readiness uses the existing owner-private call setup authority only with agents:read; otherwise not_checked. Customer coverage and outbound call permission remain not_checked. This read differs from the shared phone-system API configuration flag and changes nothing.

tools.name: add_team_phone
tools.title: Add Team Phone
tools.description: Add a teammate's (or the owner's) cell to the phones that ring before Kai answers. Idempotent — a cell already listed is reported as already included. Owners and admins are also registered on the admin roster, so calling the business line from that cell reaches the admin secretary; a member only rings. The business's own forwarded-from office line is refused (forwarding_loop) because ringing it would bounce the call straight back. Requires the phone system to be set up first (set_up_phone_system).

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.title: List SMS Conversations
tools.description: List SMS conversation threads (counterparty timeline metadata) for the authenticated business, most recent first.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.title: Get SMS Conversation
tools.description: Get a single SMS conversation thread by ID.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.title: Get Webhook Configuration
tools.description: List the configured outbound webhook(s) for a business, including supported event types.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.title: Set Webhook
tools.description: Create or update a business outbound webhook (URL + subscribed events). Returns a webhook secret on first creation only.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.title: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Remove a business outbound webhook by ID.

tools.name: list_evals
tools.title: List Agent Evals
tools.description: List saved test scenarios for an agent (or all accessible agents). A new agent has none; create_eval adds one.
