tools.name: create_eval
tools.title: Create Agent Test Scenario
tools.description: Save a test scenario for one of the business's agents: what a caller says and what the agent's reply must do to pass. run_eval then grades the agent against it. Saving places no call and changes nothing on the agent.

tools.name: run_eval
tools.title: Run Agent Eval
tools.description: Run a saved test scenario against one of the business's agents and grade the agent's replies: pass eval_id for one scenario, or agent_id for every scenario saved for that agent (see list_evals). The test is a simulated text conversation with the agent's current live configuration; no phone call is placed, no customer is contacted and the agent's configuration is not changed. Each run uses paid voice-agent provider capacity and is recorded with its result. Returns pass or fail per scenario with the grader's reasons.

tools.name: find_voices
tools.title: Find Voices for an Agent
tools.description: Find the three voices that best match a plain description of what the owner wants (for example 'a Southern man who can also speak Spanish' or 'warm older woman, calm'), and get a page link where the owner can play each one in English and Spanish, pick one to switch the agent's voice, and undo within 24 hours. Show the owner the page link; nothing changes until they pick. The link expires in 7 days.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.title: List Voice Catalog
tools.description: List the curated, credential-free voice catalog (id, display name, accent, language, gender, sample URL) used to configure agent voices.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.title: Create Agent
tools.description: Create a new KaiCalls agent — the secretary that answers this business’s calls (the live voice agent plus KaiCalls records) — with a system prompt, greeting, voice, and model. Its starting settings are saved as version 1 and each later change as a new version (list_config_versions); rollback_config restores a version's greeting, voice, prompt, model and summary/scoring. Compliance: KaiCalls automatically applies state-aware AI-disclosure and consent handling to every agent it provisions, and flags high-risk business categories for extra review.

tools.name: attach_number
tools.title: Attach Phone Number
tools.description: Assign a phone number already in the KaiCalls registry pool to a business (and optionally route it directly to an agent). Does NOT purchase a new number; search_available_numbers and buy_number handle purchases.

tools.name: attach_own_twilio_number
tools.title: Answer A Number From Your Own Twilio Account
tools.description: Have a voice agent answer calls on ONE number from the business's own connected Twilio account, calls only. Reads only that number. dry_run defaults to true and changes nothing: it returns would_change (the number's VoiceUrl and VoiceMethod) and the fields left unchanged. With dry_run false, only that number's VoiceUrl and VoiceMethod change; its text settings (SmsUrl, SmsMethod, SmsApplicationSid, StatusCallback) are read back afterwards and must be unchanged, so a texting setup another service runs on the account keeps working. Refuses a number a Twilio app answers, and a number another service answers unless replace_existing_voice is true. Uses one plan line. Requires admin role.

tools.name: detach_own_twilio_number
tools.title: Stop Answering A Number From Your Own Twilio Account
tools.description: Stop a voice agent answering a number from the business's own connected Twilio account and put back the call setting (VoiceUrl and VoiceMethod) the number had before it was attached. The number is never released from the account and its text settings are not touched. Requires admin role.

tools.name: set_owner_phone
tools.title: Set Owner Phone
tools.description: Saves the owner's own mobile number on the business record (the number Kai texts whenever it takes a call for the owner) so Kai can ring it first and so activation/forwarding follow-ups can reach a human — connecting a number alone does not prove the owner can be reached. In the acquisition flow this step comes before search_available_numbers and buy_number (#2086). US numbers only; normalized to E.164 and rejected if it cannot be validated as a US mobile/landline number. When ring_first is true (default), also configures ring-first routing so calls hit this cell before overflowing to the secretary — the same path used at signup. declined=true, in place of owner_phone, records a caller who declines to give a number as an inquiry: a KaiCalls lead, with no provisioned business or number.

tools.name: detach_number
tools.title: Detach Phone Number
tools.description: Release a phone number from a business back to the unassigned registry pool.

tools.name: search_available_numbers
tools.title: Search Available Numbers
tools.description: Search the carrier for phone numbers available to purchase (live number inventory). In the acquisition flow this follows set_owner_phone, which saves a reachable owner number or records a decline.

tools.name: buy_number
tools.title: Buy Phone Number
tools.description: Request a real phone-number purchase. This is APPROVAL-GATED: the carrier bills immediately on execution, so the tool only prepares a request for authenticated owner review. Caller-supplied human_confirmed, dashboard_session, or system_policy fields never authorize execution. Returns the stored request and a review URL for the owner; while approval is pending, no number has been purchased. Existing entitlement and carrier reservation checks still apply. In the acquisition flow this follows set_owner_phone, which saves a reachable owner number or records a decline.

result.description: On executed: { number, voice_agent_registered, agent_attached, compliance: { high_risk_category, disclosure_note } }.

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.title: List Agent Knowledge
tools.description: List agent knowledge base entries for a business.

tools.name: upsert_knowledge
tools.title: Create or Update Agent Knowledge
tools.description: Create a new agent knowledge base entry, or update one when `id` is provided. Creating requires title, content, and content_type.

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List Agent Products
tools.description: List a business's agent product catalog.

tools.name: upsert_product
tools.title: Create or Update Agent Product
tools.description: Create a new product row, or update one when `id` is provided. Creating requires name and business_id. Pass `quantity` to set/update inventory.

tools.name: get_agent_config
tools.title: Get Agent Configuration
tools.description: Read an agent's settings as the owner edits them: the editable inbound, outbound and text prompts, greeting, voice (with its list_voices id when it has one), model, call length, transfer settings, and the call summary and lead score instructions. Read this before update_agent_config: inbound_prompt there replaces the whole prompt, so edit the text returned here.

tools.name: list_config_versions
tools.title: List Agent Config Versions
tools.description: List the saved versions of an agent's settings, newest first: what saved each one (source), what changed (diff_summary), who (created_by) and which version a rollback came from. Secrets are never included. Pass `version` to fetch one version's full saved settings (config_snapshot). That snapshot holds the compiled prompt; to edit the prompt, read get_agent_config instead.

tools.name: get_change_history
tools.title: Get Agent Change History
tools.description: List an agent's recent config-change audit trail (change_type, change_source, old/new value, timestamp) — the same change log the owner hears when they call their line and ask what changed. Every change KaiCalls makes to an agent (via update_agent_config, configure_agent_business_rules, the owner's call-in line, or the dashboard) is logged here. Rows carry no version number; to undo a change, pick a version from list_config_versions and use rollback_config.

tools.name: rollback_config
tools.title: Rollback Agent Configuration
tools.description: Request a rollback to a saved version of the agent settings. It restores the version's greeting, voice, prompt (and the editable prompt copy, when the version saved one), model and call summary/scoring. Transfer settings, call length, tools and speech recognition stay as they are; the result lists what was and was not restored. When the business owner or an admin is signed in through this connector, the rollback applies immediately; otherwise the owner approves it from a review link. Targets are listed by list_config_versions. The rollback is itself saved as a new version, and secrets are never copied.

result.description: On executed: { agent_id, restored_from_version, restored_fields, skipped_fields, not_restored, new_version_number, warning? }.

tools.name: list_observability_events
tools.title: List Observability Events
tools.description: List a business-scoped timeline of compact call-runtime events and redacted integration-delivery attempts. Uses bounded keyset pagination.

tools.name: list_tool_execution_logs
tools.title: List Tool Execution Logs
tools.description: List per-call voice-agent tool execution traces — outcome, latency, timeout, and a redacted result preview for each routed tool call. Answers "did this tool call actually work".

tools.name: list_subscription_history
tools.title: List Subscription Change History
tools.description: List the business plan and price changes, newest first: upgrades, downgrades, add-ons and automatic right-size moves.

tools.name: list_overage_charges
tools.title: List Overage Charges
tools.description: List the per-period overage-minutes ledger (older per-minute-overage plans only; current plans carry no overage). GET /v1/balance/get_balance only returns an aggregate; this returns the underlying per-period ledger rows.

tools.name: list_rightsize_recommendations
tools.title: List Plan Right-Size Recommendations
tools.description: List per-period automatic plan right-size decisions, including the dry_run -> notified -> (kept | applied | superseded) lifecycle. Answers "is this business about to get right-sized".

tools.name: get_billing_contacts
tools.title: Get Invoice Email Recipients
tools.description: Read who gets the monthly invoice email for a business. Every paid invoice is always emailed to the business owner (returned masked); up to 3 extra addresses, such as a bookkeeper or office inbox, get the same email.

owner_email.description: The owner's login email, masked. The owner always gets every invoice.

tools.name: set_billing_contacts
tools.title: Set Invoice Email Recipients
tools.description: Replace the extra addresses that get the monthly invoice email (at most 3; an empty list clears them). The business owner always keeps getting every invoice and cannot be removed. Requires the current owner role on the business.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.title: Report an Issue
tools.description: Report a problem with your KaiCalls agent, phone number, billing, or account. Saves the report to your change history and notifies KaiCalls support so a person can follow up on anything broken or not working as expected.
